supporting_observations.claim: The svc-grades failures start shortly after the scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation and recur at roughly one-minute intervals, consistent with the inventory description of GradeSync re-authenticating each run.
The failed network logons identify FILE-ORC-01 as the workstation, use the same process name and PID, and report the same originating IP address (10.56.20.20).
The failed attempts report bad-credential status (0xc000006a); corresponding domain-controller validation failures also identify svc-grades and FILE-ORC-01.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records cover 13:33–13:48 UTC, not the entire requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
These records show authentication failures but do not establish whether the scheduled password rotation occurred or when the GradeSync job was updated.
No process, service-configuration, or password-change audit records were provided to independently verify the job's behavior or credential state.
claims_not_established: That the password rotation was completed at 13:30 UTC.
That the failures stopped after the GradeSync job was updated, or that there were no successful logons later in the requested window.
That the scheduled job, rather than another process on FILE-ORC-01, generated the attempts.
additional_evidence_needed: If validating the expected resolution, review password-change and GradeSync configuration/update records, plus authentication logs through 14:20 UTC.
